description: Ceiling for hard-coded colours in the Manager UI (THM-2/THM-5). Read by scripts/quality/check-manager-css-tokens.py. frozenCount may only fall; the checker fails when the count differs from it in either direction, so a cleaned screen lowers it in the same commit.

exemptReasons.tokens.css: holds the --t-* defaults (npdev-dark) by definition; check-themes.py pins them to npdev-dark.json
exemptReasons.theme-engine.js: byte-identical twin shared with generated apps; its hex literals are candidate colours for cvdSafe and bevel highlights, i.e. theme-engine data
exemptReasons.a11y.css: byte-identical twin shared with generated apps; its two hex literals are the focus-ring fallback when no theme token is set
